summary.text: Jeff Smith is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 31 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 93, from 2007 to 2010, and owned a window-cleaning business.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Smith graduated from North High School and then began working full-time for his father's business, Bob Smith Window Cleaning, which he went on to own and operate.
Before his election to the Wisconsin State Assembly, he served as Town Chair of Brunswick from 2001 to 2007.

Smith has served as chair of the Parent Advisory Council and as a member of the Eau Claire Area Chamber of Commerce, the Eau Claire Family Resource Center, the Kiwanis Club of Eau Claire, the Wisconsin Alliance for Excellent Schools and Wisconsin Conservation Voters.
In the 2025-2026 session, Smith was assigned to the Legislative Organization, Joint Legislative Council, Senate Health and Senate Organization committees.
